# commercetools_connect_connector (Resource)

A commercetools Connect connector: the Git repository and tag that Connect builds its applications from, and who may deploy it. This is the connector's staged version; with `publish` set, Terraform also publishes it, privately and without certification, to the projects in `private_projects`. Install it in a Project with a `commercetools_connect_deployment`.

A private repository must be given by its SSH URL, and the `connect-mu` GitHub user needs read access to it.

Releases are usually made outside of Terraform, by setting a new tag and publishing with the commercetools CLI (`commercetools connect connectorstaged update --repository-tag` and `commercetools connect connectorstaged publish`). Add `repository_tag` to `ignore_changes` so Terraform keeps the tag the CLI set, the way it would keep a container image a deployment pipeline set. The same CI/CD step then redeploys the deployments with `commercetools connect deployment redeploy --updateConnector`.

See also the [Connectors documentation](https://docs.commercetools.com/connect/connectors-staged).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "commercetools_connect_connector" "search_sync" {
  key               = "evolve-search-sync"
  name              = "Evolve search sync"
  description       = "Keeps the Algolia index in sync with the catalog."
  repository_url    = "git@github.com:labd/evolve-search-sync.git"
  repository_tag    = "v1.0.0"
  integration_types = ["search"]
  supported_regions = ["europe-west1.gcp"]
  private_projects  = ["europe-west1.gcp:my-project"]
  publish           = true

  creator {
    email   = "dev@example.com"
    company = "Example Company"
  }

  lifecycle {
    # Releases set a new tag with the commercetools CLI.
    ignore_changes = [repository_tag]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) User-defined unique identifier of the connector.
- `name` (String) Name of the connector.
- `repository_tag` (String) Git tag of the release to build. Usually set by the commercetools CLI on release; see the resource description.
- `repository_url` (String) HTTPS or SSH URL of the GitHub repository with the connector's `connect.yaml`. A private repository needs its SSH URL.

### Optional

- `creator` (Block, Optional) Owner of the connector. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--creator))
- `description` (String) Description of the connector.
- `documentation_url` (String) URL of the connector's documentation.
- `integration_types` (Set of String) Integration types of the connector, such as `search` or `psp`.
- `private_projects` (Set of String) Projects that can deploy the connector, as `{region}:{projectKey}`, such as `europe-west1.gcp:my-project`.
- `publish` (Boolean) Publish the connector privately once it is created and whenever Terraform changes it, and wait until Connect has published it. Defaults to `false`.
- `publish_timeout` (String) How long to wait for Connect to publish the connector, as a duration such as `45m`. Defaults to `30m`.
- `supported_regions` (Set of String) Regions the connector can be deployed in, such as `europe-west1.gcp`. Leave out for every region.

### Read-Only

- `has_changes` (Boolean) Whether the staged connector differs from the published one.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the connector.
- `published_version` (Number) Version of the published connector, following the releases published with the CLI. Null until the connector is first published.
- `status` (String) Status of the staged connector, such as `Draft`, `Processing` or `Published`.
- `version` (Number) Current version of the staged connector, raised by every change to it.

<a id="nestedblock--creator"></a>
### Nested Schema for `creator`

Required:

- `email` (String) Contact email address of the creator.

Optional:

- `company` (String) Name of the company that owns the connector.
- `logo_url` (String) URL of a logo representing the creator.
- `name` (String) Name of the person who owns the connector.
- `no_of_contributors` (Number) Number of contributors working for the company.
- `support_url` (String) URL of the connector's support website.
- `title` (String) Title of the person who owns the connector.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A connector is imported using its key.
terraform import commercetools_connect_connector.search_sync evolve-search-sync
```
